response.sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
)
SELECT tradekind,
       analysis_count,
       1.0 * analysis_count / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share_of_analyses
FROM counts;

assumptions.assumption: Trader types with no qualifying analysis records are omitted; the request counts records linked to existing transactions and traders.
